title: Tekko
extract:
The Tekko are  Atlas' signature fist weapons. Armed with razors, they boast high critical chance at the expense of range and status chance. Additionally, they gain increased status chance while wielded by Atlas.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Stance polarity has  polarity, matches  Seismic Palm and  Gaia's Tragedy stances.

Acquisition
The Tekko's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

This weapon can be sold for  5,000

Notes
As a Signature Weapon, Tekko gains a bonus effect with  Atlas or  Atlas Prime, gaining an additional 6% base Status Chance, for a total of 16%.

Tips
With a rank-10  Blood Rush, the Tekko can achieve over 100% critical chance at a 5x combo multiplier, allowing this weapon to deal orange crits.

Trivia
Tekkō (鉄甲), derived from the Japanese word for "iron" and "armor", refers to a type of fist weapon that is designed to increase the mass of the wielder's hand, and by extension the amount of force generated in a single punch.
